name: artillery-performance-tests
description: Artillery.js 기반 Next.js 성능 테스트 스위트

scripts.test:comparison: npm run test:next-direct && npm run test:proxy-cached
scripts.test:all: artillery run scenarios/basic-load-test.yml && artillery run scenarios/nextjs-direct.yml && artillery run scenarios/proxy-cached.yml && artillery run scenarios/user-patterns.yml && artillery run scenarios/scaling-test.yml
scripts.report:html: artillery run --output report.json scenarios/basic-load-test.yml && artillery report --output report.html report.json

author: Performance Testing Team
